baseline.conditions: Dry plateau to coast with two transfer days.

title: The coast is not the finish
daily_life: A caravan descends from the dry plateau toward Nacre Quay carrying goods whose ownership may be disputed once they reach water. The coast is a transfer workplace.
timing: 230 km at the loaded convoy rate of 18 km/day takes 12.78 movement days. Add the two stated transfer days: 14.78 elapsed days, scheduled as 15 whole day blocks.
handoff: Cargo accepted into a quay store is not cargo loaded onto a vessel. Keep warehouse acceptance and departure authority as separate fields.
story_option: A valuable sealed chest reaches the quay with two honest owners’ marks from different transfers. The conflict is resolved by reconstructing custody, not by opening every private item.
production: The old 14-day summary remains in the baseline record. Use the 15-day planning floor for new scenes unless a dated revised itinerary explicitly changes pace or overlap.
